messages:
keely (Design): quick UX check: proposing a compact "keys quick actions" bar (rotate/copy/revoke) accessible via keyboard (K then 1/2/3). two asks: 1) what should revoke do by default — immediate with undo toast, or require a confirm? 2) keyboard flow: should shortcut auto-open modal or show inline action?

omar (PM): product preference: fast for power users but safe for accidental taps. proposal: single-key shortcut opens the inline quick bar (not a modal). revoke from the quick bar should show a thin confirm row with 'Revoke' + 'Cancel' inline; if user has prod-tagged keys selected require typed confirm.

dev (Eng): inline confirm row is easy. typed confirm for prod keys is extra but doable. note: keyboard shortcuts need scoping so they don't trigger globally; recommend only active when key list has focus. also watch for conflicts with browser find (CTRL/CMD+F).

tara (A11y): accessibility notes: inline confirm must be programmatically focusable and announced. use role="region" aria-live="assertive" for the confirm message. keyboard users must be able to Tab into the confirm and press Enter to commit. Do NOT rely on timeouts to close the inline confirm; require explicit dismissal or completion. For the undo toast for non-prod revokes: make it keyboard-focusable and expose the Undo button to SRs (role="status" aria-live="polite").

keely (Design): updated: quick bar opens inline, not modal, via shortcut. Revoke behavior: if selection contains any prod-tag -> typed confirm modal; else show inline confirm row + undo toast after action (10s). Inline confirm is persistent until user chooses. Visual copy for inline confirm: "Confirm revoke selected keys — this stops services using them immediately." Button labels: "Revoke" (danger) and "Cancel".

omar (PM): also add a small badge on rows "prod" so users know before selecting. add a subtle hover tooltip for badges. For analytics, track quick-action usage and accidental revokes (users who immediately undo).

dev (Eng): implement notes: make quick bar a focus trap only when it's open; otherwise keyboard navigates list. typed-confirm modal must autofocus the input. Undo toast should be focusable, not auto-focused. We'll add an aria-describedby linking the toast to the revoked items count.

tara (A11y): checklist before merge: 1) confirm row is keyboard reachable and announced; 2) undo toast is reachable by keyboard and SRs get polite announcement; 3) prod badge has title and is in the DOM for SRs; 4) shortcuts scoped to list focus.

keely (Design): thanks all — i'll push updated mock and copy PR with the keyboard flow and confirm language for review.
